hero.title: Coaching that begins with you.
hero.paragraph1: I believe that meaningful change begins when you have the time and space to hear yourself think. Coaching gives us a chance to pause, get curious, and find a way forward that feels like your own.
hero.paragraph2: Whether you are navigating a change, feeling stuck, or ready to grow, our conversations focus on what matters to you—not a one-size-fits-all answer.
hero.caption: A thoughtful space to move forward

philosophy.cardTitle: There is no single right way to grow.
philosophy.cardSubtitle: We make room for your perspective and your pace.
philosophy.title: You already bring strengths to the work.
philosophy.paragraph1: Coaching is a partnership. I bring attentive questions, a supportive structure, and a fresh perspective; you bring the knowledge of your own life.
philosophy.paragraph2: We can look at what is getting in the way, notice what is already working, and explore options without rushing to a perfect answer. The aim is to help you make choices that feel considered and genuinely yours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heading: A few answers before we talk.
faq.description: Can’t find the answer you’re looking for? Get in touch and we can talk it through.

questions.question: How does the coaching process work?
questions.answer: We start with a free introductory call to understand what you are looking for. If coaching feels like a good fit, we agree on a focus and a pace together. Sessions give you space to reflect, explore options, and decide on practical next steps.

questions.question: How long is a coaching session?
questions.answer: Session length depends on the format we agree together. We can discuss the options during your introductory call.

questions.question: Who is coaching for?
questions.answer: Coaching can be useful if you want to work through a challenge, make a change, or move towards a personal or professional goal. You do not need to have everything figured out before we speak.

questions.question: Can sessions be done online?
questions.answer: Yes. Online sessions are available, so you can take part from a place that works for you.

questions.question: How do I book a first call?
questions.answer: Use the booking link to choose a preferred date and time, then send us your request by email.

questions.question: What does coaching cost?
questions.answer: Coaching fees depend on the type and level of support you are looking for. We discuss the available options and costs before you decide whether to begin.

questions.question: Is coaching the same as therapy?
questions.answer: Coaching focuses on reflection, goals, and forward-looking action. It is not a substitute for therapy or medical care. If you need clinical support, please contact a qualified healthcare professional.
